security.csp: default-src 'self' ipc: http://ipc.localhost; img-src 'self' data: https://i.ytimg.com; frame-src https://www.youtube-nocookie.com; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; script-src 'self'; connect-src ipc: http://ipc.localhost

bundle.shortDescription: Turn any file into a black-and-white pixel video, and back.
bundle.longDescription: ATV (Anything To Video) turns any file or folder into a black-and-white pixel video and turns the video back into the exact original files, with optional encryption and a Robust mode that survives sites like YouTube and WhatsApp.
